name: hold-to-commit
title: Hold to Commit
description: An important action fills while you press and hold, and only confirms when the fill completes; letting go early drains it back.

meta.reducedMotion: The fill still shows progress (it's information) but with a linear, unanimated drain.
meta.useWhen: Irreversible or weighty actions: delete, publish, donate, sign.
meta.avoidWhen: Everyday actions; anything time-critical; as the only way to confirm (keyboard users get Enter-to-hold too).
